facts.fact: The BCRG governor said financial access rose from 4% in 2011 to nearly 36% in 2024 thanks notably to the rise of electronic money, which implies e-money in service.

NimbaPay, in service from its 22 July 2026 launch, lets clients of connected institutions make instant, interoperable transfers between accounts regardless of their bank or financial service provider, across banks, e-money institutions and microfinance institutions.
NimbaPay is described as Guinea's national instant payment system, connecting banks, e-money institutions and microfinance institutions, in service from 22 July 2026.

systems.owner: BCRG, implemented by Guineenne de Monetique
